A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (stat boxes and corrected game text), meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-mse6mousedroid-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid]]: The game text is reworded: “Landspeed = 3. Deploys to same site as a character targeted by a Utinni Effect (except Kessel Run). If this droid 'reaches' Utinni Effect, may relocate it here. Upon delivery, 'mouse' droid returns to your hand.” The slip adds a black strip below the text box with a white italic “E”.

The same area of the printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
